name: HC28b: Total Tested
description:
Number of eligible pregnant or breastfeeding women active on ART whose most recent viral load test as of the reporting-period end occurred during the preceding 3 months.
The patient must meet HC28a eligibility criteria, and the patient's most recent qualifying VL episode on or before :endDate must have occurred within the previous three months. Testing must be supported by specimen, clinical VL date, laboratory result, or valid result evidence; an order without evidence that testing occurred is not sufficient.

            OR v.is_valid_result = 1
        )

        AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM mamba_fact_viral_load_episode v2
            WHERE v2.patient_id = v.patient_id

              AND (
                  v2.sample_collection_date IS NOT NULL
                  OR v2.viral_load_clinical_date IS NOT NULL
                  OR v2.laboratory_result_date IS NOT NULL
                  OR v2.is_valid_result = 1
